lines.en: label amicamp2:
scene black
You know...I think I’ve killed enough time wandering around the forest.
lines.zh: 你知道吗……我觉得我在森林里晃悠的时间已经够多了。

lines.en: I’ve gone fishing with Maki...I sat by the river with Yuki...I’ve even [[REDACTED] with Kaori and [[TEMPLATE9].
lines.zh: 我和 Maki 一起去钓过鱼……我和 Yuki 一起坐在河边……我甚至和 Kaori、[[TEMPLATE9]] 一起 [[REDACTED] 过。

lines.en: And in the event that Sara is still not done “bonding” with Ami, I’m just going to have to make her my temporary wife in order to reinsert myself into Ami’s day.
lines.zh: 万一 Sara 还没和 Ami「培养完感情」,我大概只好让她当我的临时妻子,好把自己重新塞回 Ami 的一天里。

lines.en: This trip was meant to strengthen our bond, after all. And as appreciative as I am to have someone like Sara who is going way out of her way to bring some maternal influence back into Ami’s life, I-
lines.zh: 毕竟,这趟旅行本来就是为了加深我们的羁绊。虽然我很感激有 Sara 这样的人,愿意大费周章,给 Ami 的生活重新注入一点母性的影响,但我——

lines.en: scene camphair1
: Let me move in with you. Let me be her mom.
lines.zh: : 让我搬来和你们一起住吧。让我当她妈妈。

lines.en: scene camphair2
I suddenly remember that there is someone else I was supposed to give that role to.
lines.zh: 我突然想起来,那个角色,我本该留给另一个人。

lines.en: scene camphair3
I suddenly remember that I had the building blocks to form a real family firmly in my hands and all I’ve done with them is build another wall.
lines.zh: 我突然想起来,组建一个真正家庭的积木曾经牢牢握在我手里,而我用它们搭起来的,却是又一堵墙。

lines.en: scene camphair4
But this one was made specially for Niki — a girl I’ve known forever who wants nothing more than to be a bigger player in the game that I call life.
lines.zh: 但这堵墙是专门为 Niki 造的——一个我认识了一辈子的女孩,她唯一的愿望,就是在我这场名为人生的游戏里,当个更大的玩家。

lines.en: scene camphair5
But for some reason, I still struggle with the thought of putting her through that.
lines.zh: 但不知为何,一想到让她经历这些,我依然挣扎。

lines.en: scene black
I swear, this game would be so much easier if that family would just fuck off already.
lines.zh: 我发誓,要是那家人肯干脆滚蛋,这场游戏会容易得多。

lines.en: scene camphair6
scene white
scene camphair7
: I’m back from where I was before.
lines.zh: : 我从刚才待的地方回来啦。

lines.en: : I feel like I literally just saw you.
lines.zh: : 我感觉我刚刚才见过你。

lines.en: : Yeah, same.
lines.zh: : 对,我也是。

lines.en: : I know I make things about myself a lot, but I just want to say I’m quite offended that you’ve hung out with literally everyone but me.
lines.zh: : 我知道我总爱把话题绕回自己身上,但我只想说一句:你和所有人——字面意义上的所有人——都玩了,唯独没跟我玩,我相当受伤。

lines.en: : Not everyone. I’ve still barely seen Sara and Ami. But, now that I mention it-
lines.zh: : 也没有所有人嘛。Sara 和 Ami 我也几乎没见着。不过既然说起来了——

lines.en: scene camphair8
: Don’t worry. She’s not stealing her or trying to take your place or anything. I’m sure they’ll be done soon.
lines.zh: : 别担心。她没有抢走她,也没想取代你的位置什么的。我确信她们很快就完了。

lines.en: : But, then again, I could be wrong since I wasn’t allowed in there either.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来,我也可能判断错,因为她们也不让我进去。

lines.en: : Probably because you would have made things weird and gotten some sort of animal penis involved.
lines.zh: : 大概因为你会把气氛搞怪,顺便扯进什么动物的肉棒吧。

lines.en: scene camphair9
: We’re in nature, Sensei. There are animal penises everywhere.
lines.zh: : 我们在大自然里诶,Sensei。动物的肉棒到处都是。

lines.en: : I can’t make them any more involved than they already are.
lines.zh: : 我总不能让它们比现在更深度参与了。

lines.en: : I don’t like the way you look at nature, Maki.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你看大自然的眼神,Maki。

lines.en: : Sara’s got some weird fuckin’ friends, huh?
lines.zh: : Sara 的朋友一个个怪得要命, huh?

lines.en: scene camphair10
: We weren’t always this bad. But things have really gone to shit over the last few years and now this is sort of just where we’re at.
lines.zh: : 我们以前没这么糟。但过去几年事情真的烂透了,现在我们大概就烂在这里了。

lines.en: : Wack. Feel like it’s the complete opposite for me.
lines.zh: : 离谱。我怎么感觉完全相反。

lines.en: : If you’re that worried, why not just head over to their tent? I feel like you could have been with them this entire time if you really wanted. Neither one of them is going to deny you.
lines.zh: : 你要真那么担心,怎么不直接去她们帐篷?我觉得只要你真心想,你早就能和她们待在一起了。她们俩谁都不会拒绝你。

lines.en: : Wasn’t I kind of denied already? Like, the only reason I wandered around at all is because Sara made it sound like this was something only she and Ami were-
lines.zh: : 我不是已经被拒绝过了吗?我到处瞎晃的唯一原因,就是 Sara 把这说得像她和 Ami 两个人的专——

lines.en: : What’s this about Sara and Ami?
lines.zh: : Sara 和 Ami 怎么了?

lines.en: scene camphair11
: Oh, wow. That’s certainly a drastic change.
lines.zh: : 哦,哇。这变化可真彻底。
: Ami?……

lines.en: scene camphair12
: That’s right! Surprise!
lines.zh: : 没错!惊喜!

lines.en: : You...cut that much off?...
lines.zh: : 你……剪了那么多?……

lines.en: scene camphair13
: I kind of had to. Like, maybe I could have gotten away with leaving it a little longer. But it was so uneven that I figured it’d make the most sense to just completely clean it up and start fresh.
lines.zh: : 我有点不得不。呃,也许再留长一点也行。但它实在太参差了,我想最合理的做法就是彻底修干净,从头再来。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : Do you hate it?...
lines.zh: : 你讨厌吗?……

lines.en: : I know you’ve always preferred longer hair, but...it’s like Sara said. It was just...too messed up to really save.
lines.zh: : 我知道你一直更喜欢长发,但是……就像 Sara 说的。它已经……烂到救不回来了。

lines.en: scene camphair14
: It...It’ll grow back, though! So you only have to deal with having someone who looks more like a nephew for a little while and...I can wear even girlier clothes to try and make up for-
lines.zh: : 它……它还会长的!所以你只需要忍受一个看起来更像侄子的家伙一小段时间,然后……我可以穿更女人味的衣服来补偿——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不用。

lines.en: scene camphair15
: I still think you’re adorable. It’s just...really different.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得你很可爱。只是……真的很不一样。

lines.en: scene camphair16
: Y...Yeah...
: I don’t even want to think of what the other girls will say if...any of them are still willing to talk to me.
lines.zh: : 我都不敢想其他女孩会说什么,要是……她们里还有谁愿意理我的话。

lines.en: : I know this isn’t the best time, but I’m going to need at least 8,000 yen for the haircut. You can just Venmo me if you don’t have cash.
lines.zh: : 我知道现在说这个不合时宜,但理发我得收你至少 8000 日元。没现金的话 Venmo 转我就行。

lines.en: scene camphair17
: Sara...come on.
lines.zh: : Sara……拜托。

lines.en: : Kidding, kidding. Your uncle’s given me more than enough money with all the booze he’s bought over the last few years. This is the least I can do.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑开玩笑。这几年你叔叔买酒花的钱,已经够我赚的了。这是我至少能做的。

lines.en: scene camphair18
: Which means, now it’s his turn!
lines.zh: : 这么说,现在轮到他了!

lines.en: : My turn to what?
lines.zh: : 轮到我干什么?

lines.en: : Spend some time with Ami, of course! That’s what you’ve been waiting for ever since we got here, is it not? Because I know for sure that’s what Ami’s been looking forward to.
lines.zh: : 陪 Ami 待一会儿啊!我们从到这里开始,你不就一直在等这个吗?因为我可以肯定,Ami 一直盼的就是这个。

lines.en: : And now she gets to do that without feeling super self-conscious about the way she looks!
lines.zh: : 而且现在她终于可以不用对自己的样子那么不自在了!

lines.en: : I mean...don’t get me wrong...I think you did a great job, but...I wouldn’t say I’m not self-conscious anymore. This is the first time I’ve ever even had short hair. It’ll take a little while to...get used to.
lines.zh: : 话说……别误会……我觉得你剪得很好,但……我也不能说我就完全不尴尬了。这是我人生第一次留短发。得花点时间……适应。

lines.en: : Sara...
lines.zh: : Sara……

lines.en: : Sarasaki86.
lines.zh: : Sarasaki86。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : My Venmo name.
lines.zh: : 我的 Venmo 用户名。

lines.en: : I don’t even know what that is.
lines.zh: : 我连那是什么都不知道。

lines.en: scene camphair19
: Please forgive my uncle...he’s kind of illiterate when it comes to technology.
lines.zh: : 请原谅我叔叔……他对科技这方面基本是文盲。

lines.en: : And you’re kind of illiterate when it comes to literacy, but I love you anyway.
lines.zh: : 而你对识字这方面基本是文盲,但我照样爱你。

lines.en: scene camphair20
: You’re...saying that in front of other people now?!
lines.zh: : 你现在……当着别人的面说这种话?!

lines.en: : That was the single cutest thing I have ever heard come out of your mouth and I would like you to say it again right now.
lines.zh: : 这是我这辈子从你嘴里听过的最可爱的一句话,我要求你立刻再说一遍。

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不要。

lines.en: : I’ll waive the haircut fee.
lines.zh: : 那我免去你的理发费。

lines.en: : I love you, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我爱你,Ami。

lines.en: scene camphair21
: Kyaaaah! My heart!
lines.zh: : 呀!我的心脏!

lines.en: : I...love you too. More than anything in the whole wide world.
lines.zh: : 我……也爱你。胜过这整个广阔世界上的一切。

lines.en: : That’s good to hear.
lines.zh: : 听到这个真好。

lines.en: scene black
: I guess...shall we go for a walk then?
lines.zh: : 我猜……那我们要不要去散个步?

lines.en: : Y...Yeah!
: Have fun, you two! But remember that there are bears around here!
lines.zh: : 玩得开心,你们俩!不过记住这附近有熊!

lines.en: : And remember that Maki is probably thinking about their penises!
lines.zh: : 也记住 Maki 大概正在想它们的肉棒!

lines.en: : Well I am now. Thanks a lot, Haru-kun.
lines.zh: : 好吧,现在是了。多谢了,Haru-kun。

lines.en: : Aight. That’s enough of this shit. I’m takin’ a smoke break.
lines.zh: : 得了。这种话听够了。我去抽根烟。

lines.en: : You’re literally smoking right now, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 你现在就在抽烟啊,Yuki。

lines.en: : I can handle two at once.
lines.zh: : 我能同时抽两根。

lines.en: : Ahh, another woman of culture.
lines.zh: : 啊,又一位有品位的女中豪杰。

lines.en: : I’m more than content with one so long as it belongs to the man that I love.
lines.zh: : 有一根就心满意足了——只要它属于我爱的那个男人。

lines.en: : Can we...maybe start walking now? So we don’t have to listen to this anymore?...
lines.zh: : 我们……能不能现在就开始走?这样我们就不用再听这个了?……

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t want to be around another second of this either.
lines.zh: : 好,我也一秒都不想多待。

lines.en: scene sky
And so the two of us set off toward the middle of nowhere.
lines.zh: 于是我们俩动身,朝着无人之境的中央走去。

lines.en: scene noonsky
And we keep walking until the sun sets.
lines.zh: 我们一直走,直到日落。

lines.en: Ami fills me in on all of the things she talked about with Sara.
lines.zh: Ami 向我转述了她和 Sara 聊过的一切。

lines.en: As you may have guessed, I was a hot topic when it came to conversation. But Ami assured me that she managed to keep her most impure feelings out of the equation for my sake.
lines.zh: 你可能猜到了,我成了谈话的热门话题。但 Ami 向我保证,为了我,她把最不纯洁的想法排除在了谈话之外。

lines.en: if amifingered == False:
And while that’s nice and all, I wish she’d keep them out of her head entirely as they’re going to be even less acceptable once I fit better into the role I was meant to inhabit years ago.
lines.zh: 虽然这听着挺好,但我真希望她能把它们从脑子里也彻底排除——因为等我真正 fit 进那个我多年前就该扮演的角色之后,那些想法只会更加不可接受。

lines.en: else:
Which is great because after commanding me to cum inside of her probably over a hundred times now, I think it’s safe to say those feelings are pretty impure.
lines.zh: 这很合理——毕竟她命令我去在她里面大概已经上百次,我可以说那些感情相当不纯洁。

lines.en: Such comments probably shouldn’t sprout up on a trip where I’ve pledged to become more of a father though.
lines.zh: 但在我发誓要更像一个父亲的这趟旅行上,这种话大概不该冒出来。

lines.en: A good father doesn’t cum inside his daughter. A good father cums on her face. Or into a ball of napkins she presses against the head of his cock when the time comes for him to let loose.
lines.zh: : 一个好父亲,不会去在女儿身体里。一个好父亲,去在她脸上。或者——在他释放的那一刻,射进她按在他前端的那团纸巾里。

lines.en: But again, that doesn’t matter right now.
lines.zh: : 但话说回来,现在不重要。

lines.en: I can’t avoid this any longer. And I certainly can’t afford to let her break again because she barely has any hair to cut off now and I’m worried about what she’d lose next.
lines.zh: : 我没法再逃避了。我也绝不能再让她崩溃一次——因为她现在已经没多少头发可剪,而我很担心她下一个会失去什么。

lines.en: scene black
I’m worried about a lot of things, really.
lines.zh: : 其实,我担心的事情很多。

lines.en: I’m worried about whether she even wants to look at me any differently than a worthless uncle she needs to take care of.
lines.zh: : 我担心,她到底愿不愿意换个眼光看我——而不是一个需要她照顾的废物叔叔。

lines.en: I’m worried about her feeling worthless in her own regard if I start to do more things around the house on my own.
lines.zh: : 我担心,如果我开始独自操持更多家务,她会不会觉得自己失去了价值。

lines.en: I’m worried of whether or not her friends are still her friends or if she’ll need to find new ones. And I’m worried about whether she even wants friends in the first place when all she ever thinks about is me.
lines.zh: : 我担心她的朋友还是不是她的朋友,或者她会不会需要交新朋友。我也担心——既然她满脑子都是我——她到底还想不想要朋友。

lines.en: scene camphair22
But most of all, I’m worried about her growing up.
lines.zh: : 但最重要的,我担心她长大。

lines.en: Which is irrational given the type of world we live in, yes. And further exacerbated by the fact that I’ve been both subtly and not-so-subtly prompting her to grow up for years now.
lines.zh: : 是的,鉴于我们活着的这个世界,这很不理性。而且多年来,我一直或明或暗地催促她长大,这让情况雪上加霜。

lines.en: Was all of that just me lying to myself?
lines.zh: : 那一切,难道只是我在自欺欺人?

lines.en: Do I really want an Ami who can avoid clinging to me? Who lets me stay out late and do whatever I want without so much as a care in the world?
lines.zh: : 我真的想要一个不再黏着我的 Ami 吗?一个任我晚归、任我随心所欲、连眼皮都不抬一下的 Ami?

lines.en: Or do I want someone who will keep me in her heart at all hours of the day?
lines.zh: : 还是说我想要一个时时刻刻把我放在心里的人?

lines.en: Who will call me over and over and over again, hundreds or thousands of times until I’m feeling brave enough to pick up the phone.
lines.zh: : 一个会一遍又一遍、几百次几千次地打给我——直到我鼓起勇气接起电话的人?

lines.en: Does the type of Ami I’ll have even matter? Or is it just her I want in general?
lines.zh: : 我会拥有哪种 Ami,根本不由我吗?还是说,我想要的只是「她」这个人本身?

lines.en: I have no way of knowing, really. And I think for a moment that this just might be what being a parent feels like.
lines.zh: : 我真的无从得知。有那么一瞬间,我觉得这大概就是为人父母的感觉。

lines.en: But then I remember how it felt to be a child.
lines.zh: : 但随即我想起,当个孩子是什么滋味。

lines.en: And how I’m probably just being delusional again.
lines.zh: : 想起我多半又在自欺欺人。

lines.en: : Do you believe in God, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你信神吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : Do you?
lines.zh: : 你信吗?

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 我信。

lines.en: : Maya makes fun of me for it sometimes, but I think that He’s real.
lines.zh: : Maya 有时会笑话我,但我觉得祂是真的。

lines.en: : I don’t know if He’s watching every second of every day, but I think He’s there.
lines.zh: : 我不知道祂是否时时刻刻都在注视,但我觉得祂在那里。

lines.en: : And I think that all of the suffering that you and I have endured is just His way of testing us.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得,你我承受过的所有苦难,只是祂考验我们的方式。

lines.en: : Testing us for what?
lines.zh: : 考验我们什么?

lines.en: : To see if we are worthy of Heaven.
lines.zh: : 看我们配不配得上天堂。

lines.en: : To see if we can endure the harshness of reality and overcome adversity in order to gain one of the many limited seats in the giant sky castle all good boys and girls go to when they die.
lines.zh: : 看我们能不能扛住现实的严酷、跨越逆境,好赢得那座巨大天空之城里的一个限定席位——所有好孩子死后都会去的地方。

lines.en: : Adversity is a pretty big word for you, Ami.
lines.zh: : 「逆境」这个词,对你说有点大了,Ami。

lines.en: : Well, God’s a pretty big thing. He deserves bigger words.
lines.zh: : 嗯,神是个很大的存在嘛。祂配得上更大的词。

lines.en: scene camphair23
: To be honest, I don’t really know what I believe.
lines.zh: : 说实话,我不太确定自己信什么。

lines.en: : I want to say I don’t. But sometimes I feel like that might just be me lying to myself since there’s rarely a time where things are going terribly that I’m not either blaming or talking to god God.
lines.zh: : 我想说不信。但有时我觉得那只是我在自欺——因为每当事情一团糟,我总在怪神、或者在跟 god 说话。

lines.en: : I still instinctively want to pray when something bad happens. I just typically decide against it because it feels like...submitting.
lines.zh: : 坏事发生时,我仍然会本能地想祈祷。只是我通常选择不,因为那感觉像……屈服。

lines.en: : What’s wrong with submitting to something you believe in?
lines.zh: : 向你信仰的东西屈服,有什么问题吗?

lines.en: : The fact that I don’t know if I actually believe it. Because there’s a chance I only want to pray in the first place because I was conditioned to want that.
lines.zh: : 问题在于,我不知道我是不是真的信。因为有可能,我之所以想祈祷,只是因为从小被训练出了这个习惯。

lines.en: : If I’m conditioned to hug a teddy bear every time I’m feeling sad just because someone gave me one when I was little, does that make wanting to hug a teddy bear wrong now that I’m older and can buy my own?
lines.zh: : 如果小时候有人送了我一只泰迪熊,于是我每次难过都想抱它——那如今我长大了、能自己买了,想抱泰迪熊还算是错的吗?

lines.en: : Not...necessarily.
lines.zh: : 不……一定不算。

lines.en: : Also, is it just me, or have we had this conversation before?
lines.zh: : 还有,是我错觉吗,还是我们以前聊过一模一样的话题?

lines.en: scene camphair24
: We’ve probably had it before.
lines.zh: : 我们大概聊过。

lines.en: : In fact, there are probably tons of conversations we’ve had before that we’re going to forget about and then have again.
lines.zh: : 事实上,大概有无数段对话我们聊过、忘了,然后还会再聊一遍。

lines.en: : That’s kind of just what happens when you spend so much time with somebody, I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得,和一个人相处久了,大概就是这样。

lines.en: : Do you think our answers will ever change?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们的答案有一天会变吗?

lines.en: scene camphair25
: I don’t think there’s anything off limits for change now that my hair is completely gone.
lines.zh: : 既然我的头发已经彻底没了,我觉得现在没有什么是不可以变的。

lines.en: : The dark circles might take a little longer to get rid of, though. But Sara gave me a few tips on how to treat them.
lines.zh: : 不过黑眼圈大概要多花点时间才能消。Sara 教了我几个护理的小窍门。

lines.en: : I don’t mind those sticking around. They make you look like a...cute zombie or something.
lines.zh: : 黑眼圈留着我不介意。它们让你看起来像一只……可爱的丧尸什么的。

lines.en: : I didn’t know you were into that sort of thing, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你有这种癖好,Sensei。

lines.en: scene camphair26
: It was an earlier talking point.
lines.zh: : 这是之前聊过的话题。

lines.en: : Besides, there are probably a lot of things you don’t know about me.
lines.zh: : 再说了,你不了解我的地方,大概还有很多。

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : And the same goes for me.
lines.zh: : 我对你也是。

lines.en: : But if there’s anything you ever want to know-
lines.zh: : 但你有什么想知道的——

lines.en: : Ami...am I on the right track right now?
lines.zh: : Ami……我现在走在正确的路上吗?

lines.en: scene camphair27
: The right track? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 正确的路?什么意思?

lines.en: : With this...parenting thing.
lines.zh: : 就这个……当爸爸的事。

lines.en: : Like, is this something you actually want? Or is it something I’ve just decided you need?
lines.zh: : 就是说,这真的是你想要的吗?还是我只是单方面认定了你需要它?

lines.en: scene camphair28
: I’ve been your uncle forever. You’ve been my niece forever. And I’ve been all sorts of fucked up lately, so it’s highly plausible that this is just some sort of delusion I cooked up and...
lines.zh: : 我做你的叔叔做了一辈子。你做我的侄女做了一辈子。而我最近一团糟,所以很有可能,这只是我脑子发热编出来的妄想,然后……

lines.en: : And I don’t want to change anything if that’s going to fuck with your head since I know the two of us are pretty against change to begin with.
lines.zh: : 我不想改变任何东西——如果那只会搅乱你的脑子。毕竟我知道,我们俩本来就都抗拒改变。

lines.en: : Is it really changing anything, though?
lines.zh: : 可这真的算改变什么吗?

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思?

lines.en: scene camphair29
if amimaster.lower() in ["daddy", "dad", "papa"]:
: I mean...you basically are my dad already. I’ve just never really called you that outside of sex because I didn’t want to put any pressure on you.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你基本上早就是我爸爸了。只是在做那件事之外,我从来没这么叫过你——因为我不想给你压力。

lines.en: else:
: I mean...you basically are my dad already. I’ve just never really called you that because I didn’t want to put any pressure on you.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你基本上早就是我爸爸了。我只是一直没这么叫过你——因为我不想给你压力。

lines.en: scene camphair30
: Like, don’t get me wrong. I love things like this and nothing would make me happier than to experience more special outings with you to make more special memories, but...
lines.zh: : 就是说,别误会。我很喜欢这样的日子,没有什么比和你创造更多特别的回忆、进行更多特别的出行更让我开心了,但是……

lines.en: scene camphair31
: You don’t need to do this kind of stuff to make me look at you that way.
lines.zh: : 你不需要做这些,才能让我那样看你。

lines.en: : You don’t need to change anything at all.
lines.zh: : 你不需要改变任何东西。

lines.en: : You’re doing great.
lines.zh: : 你已经做得很好了。

lines.en: : And I’m excited for you to keep being my dad for the rest of our lives.
lines.zh: : 而且我很期待,在余生里,你继续当我的爸爸。

lines.en: scene camphair32
: Is it...okay if I call you that now?...
lines.zh: : 那我……现在可以那样叫你了吗?……

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Do you...
lines.zh: : 那你……

lines.en: : Do you think my first dad would be okay with it?...
lines.zh: : 你觉得我的第一个爸爸会同意吗?……

lines.en: : Because I’ve tried asking him, but...I never really get a response.
lines.zh: : 因为我有试过问他,但是……我从来没有得到过回应。

lines.en: : I have no idea...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : I think he would...
lines.zh: : 我想他会的……

lines.en: : And...besides-
lines.zh: : 而且……再说了——

lines.en: scene camphair33
: Besides! There’s always the chance that I could be, like...your actual daughter anyway, right?
lines.zh: : 再说了!反正说不定我就是……你亲生的女儿,对吧?

lines.en: scene camphair34
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Like...I already know you loved my mom, so...
lines.zh: : 就是……我早知道你爱过我妈妈,所以……

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be crazy if you guys might have...you know...
lines.zh: : 如果你们可能……你懂的……那也不算疯狂吧……

lines.en: scene camphair35
: It wouldn’t be crazy if I was your real daughter anyway! Right?!
lines.zh: : 如果我本来就是你的亲生女儿,一点都不疯狂吧!对吧?!

lines.en: : Right?...
scene camphair36
: Are...
lines.zh: : 你是不是……

lines.en: : Is...everything okay?
lines.zh: : 一切……都还好吗?

lines.en: : I just don’t really know what to say to that, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我真的不知道该对这句话说什么,Ami。

lines.en: : Should I...not have said that?
lines.zh: : 我是不是……不该说那个?

lines.en: : How long has that thought been in your head?
lines.zh: : 这个念头在你脑子里放了多久了?

lines.en: scene camphair37
: Kind of...loooooong...
: And...that hasn’t changed the way you look at me?
lines.zh: : 而且……这没有改变你看我的眼光?

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
scene camphair38
: Honestly?...
lines.zh: : 说实话?……

lines.en: : I think it makes it more exciting.
lines.zh: : 我觉得它让事情更刺激了。

lines.en: : And significantly less legal, probably.
lines.zh: : 而且合法程度大概显著下降了。

lines.en: else:
scene camphair39
: Oh, not at all.
lines.zh: : 哦,完全没有。

lines.en: : If anything, it just makes me want to carry your incest babies even more. And my hope in telling you this is that you will now revisit your stance when it comes to having sex with me.
lines.zh: : 硬要说的话,它只会让我更想给你生乱伦宝宝。而我告诉你这些的希望是:你现在会重新审视你「要不要和我做」的立场。

lines.en: : You think you being my actual daughter would increase the chance of that?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你是我亲女儿,会增加那个可能性?

lines.en: : I’ll take any chance I can get at this point.
lines.zh: : 事到如今,任何可能性我都不会放过。

lines.en: scene camphair40
: You know what? Let’s just...shelve that thought for now and...revisit it one day when I’m feeling a little less broken.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗?我们干脆……把这个念头先搁置,等哪天我没这么破碎了……再回来讨论。

lines.en: : Sure. Of course, if that’s what makes you happy.
lines.zh: : 好。当然,只要那能让你开心。

lines.en: : Can I...still call you Dad though?
lines.zh: : 那我……还是可以叫你爸爸吧?

lines.en: scene camphair41
: Yeah.
lines.zh: : 可以。

lines.en: : Like...in front of other people, though?
lines.zh: : 就是……当着别人的面也可以?

lines.en: : Wherever and whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 随时随地,你想叫就叫。

lines.en: : And...you’re not worried about what they might think?
lines.zh: : 而且……你不担心别人会怎么想?

lines.en: : You’re my number one priority now, Ami.
lines.zh: : 现在,你就是我的第一位,Ami。

lines.en: scene camphair42
: Now?
: Did I say “now?” I meant “always.”
lines.zh: : 我是说「一直」。刚才说成「现在」了。

lines.en: : Mhm. Nice cover.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。补救得不错。

lines.en: scene camphair43

: I just hope this doesn’t mean Ayane is going to try and call you Dad as well. She hates when I have things that she doesn’t and I’ve never once complained that her allegedly biological father is alive.
lines.zh: : 我只希望别搞得 Ayane 也想叫你爸爸。她见不得我有她没有的东西——而我可从来没抱怨过她那位「据称」的生父还活着。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure Ayane’s father isn’t just “alleged,” Ami.
lines.zh: : 我很确定 Ayane 的父亲不只是「据称」,Ami。

lines.en: : I know that. But mine is and I’m trying to draw parallels here.
lines.zh: : 我知道。但我的就是「据称」,我这是在强行对仗。

lines.en: scene noonsky
: Okay. I think that’s enough sitting around for now. Let’s head back to the camp.
lines.zh: : 好了。我觉得坐着发呆到此为止了。回营地吧。

lines.en: : But Daaaaaaaaaad!
: You’re going to do that all the time now, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你以后是不是要一直这么叫了?

lines.en: : Of course!
lines.zh: : 当然!

lines.en: scene black
: I have to make up for lost time.
lines.zh: : 我得把错过的时光补回来。
